selection_rationale: A uniform fast-capital gunline: six battlecruisers all sharing the same 1.5g acceleration profile, so the fleet moves and maneuvers as one cohesive unit (no doctrine mismatch between fast screens and slow capitals). Each carries a spinal coiler for burst damage plus twin coilgun batteries and 2x PD lasers, giving 12 PD turrets fleet-wide to shred incoming torpedo saturation while closing to point-blank coilgun range where accuracy and damage spike. Spending the full budget on six hulls maximizes both firepower redundancy and mutual PD coverage compared to fewer, pricier ships.
formation_rationale: A shallow wedge with one ship forward as vanguard to absorb the first exchange, a pair echeloned behind at moderate lateral/vertical offset to overlap point-defense while complicating enemy spinal-weapon firing solutions, and a flank pair further out plus a rearguard reserve. All ships stay within ~100-130km of the anchor so PD bubbles still overlap across the formation, while the z/y spread forces the enemy to choose between engaging the vanguard or exposing their broadsides to the flanking pairs.
